description: Dense Customize window transitions: System-to-Main handoff, page entry and exit, message preview typing, option help changes, immediate window-style changes, all six backgrounds, and committed appearance on Main and field return.
registration: Reuse local/findings-menu/customize-windows-main-transition-v1/dolphin without replaying Dolphin. Preserve its source disc, savestate, prefix, RTC, inputs and capture profile. All 3,600 source observations have UI clock = 38084 + VI and effect clock = 37551 + VI; the hash-verified source video index contains every VI from 0 through 3598. Register the complete shared school-grounds ambient origin at native update 64, including source effect RNG and uninitialized gameplay RNG. Every input and capture uses source VI + 64, except initial Y uses native update 76 as registered to the first frozen field presentation. Confirm Customize at source VI 411: System closes through 418, Main slides through 429, Customize first draws at 430 with fade 206 and settles at 439. Close Customize at VI 3401; its final transparent frame is 3412, Main reappears at 3413 and settles at 3422. Final Main close begins at 3501 and ordinary field updates resume at 3513. No post-origin clocks, state or random draws are adjusted. All 25 original settled window/background/Main/field captures and their full-image, effect RNG and four scenery-loop gates remain; the 220-frame case adds dense handoffs, entry/exit, initial message preview typing, option help changes and immediate theme changes. Full Customize word observations gate draft, selection and available numeric transients only while Customize is active (VI 430 through 3412). Effect clock/RNG, gameplay RNG and scenery loops are checked at every capture. Main viewport and System opacity were not observed in this capture, so their transitions are checked through images; no Main state gate is enabled. The route visits the first four options, three window styles and all six backgrounds. It does not cover a complete message preview fade/restart, option-list scrolling, color/volume/control panels, or Customize reopening. Screen-position offsets are outside this case and remain in the separate existing diagnostics.
